insight: Launched in December 2023 as the successor to MakerSuite, rebranded when Google moved from PaLM to Gemini.
name: Google AI Studio
tagline: Prototype with Gemini — prompts, multimodal, and instant API keys.
description: Google's free playground for building with Gemini — prompt design, multimodal input, structured output, and one-click export to API code. The fastest way to start building on Gemini.
edge: The free, friction-light front door to the Gemini API — prototype in-browser, then export the call as code.
pros: Grounding with Search; Vertex path to prod
cons: Rate limits and shifting model variants
Fewer granular controls than some playgrounds
